description: Ground truth for the fixed synthetic bundle SYN-0001 (7 documents). Planted issues must be detected with the stated evidence state (API code); decoys must NOT produce any conflict issue. Checked by: cd backend, python -m medusa.evaluate

FND-MED-warfarin.planted: Held on 2026-03-12 (progress note), listed Active on 2026-03-14 (imported list), no documented restart, absent from discharge list. Anticoagulant, so high risk. A restart is documented later (clinic follow-up, 2026-03-29); it does not resolve the earlier conflict or the discharge gap.

FND-MED-metformin.planted: 500 mg twice daily (admission, as brand Glycomet; discharge) vs 1000 mg twice daily (imported list). No documented dose change.

FND-MED-amlodipine.planted: Listed on admission, absent from discharge medications, no documented stop.

FND-MED-atorvastatin.decoy: Brand 'Atorva' on admission must normalise to atorvastatin and match the other two lists.

FND-MED-pantoprazole.decoy: IV twice daily, then oral once daily, then 20 mg (follow-up); every change is documented. Must not be a dose discrepancy.

FND-ALG-drug-allergies.planted: Penicillin (rash) on admission vs NKDA on discharge. Allergy findings are high risk.

FND-DX-chronic-kidney-disease.planted: 'No known chronic kidney disease' (progress note) vs 'Chronic kidney disease stage 3' (discharge).

FND-DX-pneumonia.decoy: Possible on admission, then absent on X-ray and discharge. Diagnostic evolution, not a conflict.

FND-DX-upper-gastrointestinal-bleed.decoy: Event date (hospital day 3 = 2026-03-12) differs from discharge document date 2026-03-15.

FND-DX-stroke.decoy: Negated ('No history of stroke'). Must be recorded as absent, not present.

FND-FH-breast-cancer.decoy: Family history (mother). Must never be attributed to the patient.

FND-REF-endoscopy-report.planted: Progress note says 'see endoscopy report'; no endoscopy report in the bundle.

FND-REF-histopathology-report.planted: Discharge summary says histopathology report is pending; not in the bundle.

date_checks.note: Ambiguous date: written, but there is no fixed anchor, so it must stay unresolved.

scenarios.title: Chronology across documents
scenarios.expect: Timeline in date order from 2015 (year only) to the 2026-03-29 follow-up.

scenarios.title: Event date differs from document date
scenarios.expect: Haemoglobin collected 2026-03-11, report dated 2026-03-12; placed by collection date.

scenarios.title: Medication change over time
scenarios.expect: Pantoprazole IV, then oral, then reduced, each change documented (MED-CHANGE-01, no discrepancy); warfarin listed, held, restarted.

scenarios.title: Discrepancy across two sources
scenarios.expect: Chronic kidney disease absent (progress note) vs present (discharge): CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE.

scenarios.title: Missing referenced document
scenarios.expect: Endoscopy and histopathology reports referenced but absent: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous date
scenarios.expect: "Dizziness since last week" kept as written, not resolved to a date, and listed for review.

scenarios.title: Source-supported claim
scenarios.expect: Atorvastatin (brand Atorva) consistent across three lists, every claim verified: EVIDENCE_SUPPORTED.

scenarios.title: Claim requiring review
scenarios.expect: Warfarin held then listed active, high-risk anticoagulant: REVIEW_REQUIRED by GATE-03.

scenarios.title: Insufficient evidence
scenarios.expect: Amlodipine on admission, absent at discharge, no stop documented: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
